fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAU CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: CATEGORY OF INSTITUTION
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, Unregulated Saccos, etc

fields.name: SUBMITTING INSTITUTION CODE
fields.description: Institution Code of the subscribing instutition. E.g. {Bank code issued by KBA (e.g. KCB = 01) for Commercial Banks} otherwise left blank for individuals

fields.name: SUBSCRIPTION DATE
fields.description: The when the customer or institution subscribed to the bureau

fields.name: SUBSCRIPTION STATUS
fields.description: The status of sbscription, whether Active or Dormant

fields.name: NO OF ENQUIRIES
fields.description: The number of enquiries done in the reporting period
